scope: The principal gold-spired four-porch building and adjoining roofed hall of Wat Bang Phra in Bang Kaeo Fa, with the photo-documented standing figure and forecourt. The remaining monastery buildings and interiors are outside the modeled architectural scope.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The local culture center records the historic temple at Bang Kaeo Fa, the veneration of former abbot Luang Pho Phern and the marble museum built in the compound.
The Nakhon Pathom Rajabhat University cultural record identifies the temple and the Phern collection.

constructionScope: Four-porch main hall, spire and three-step roof section, gilded standing figure, adjoining rectangular hall, and public forecourt.
